title: 03.05 - Answering a survey on a mobile phone or tablet
intent: Explain whether EUSurvey questionnaires can be answered on mobile devices.
short_answer: Yes. EUSurvey has a responsive design for published surveys, so the questionnaire adapts to the screen size and resolution of the device you use.
procedure: Open the survey link on your mobile phone or tablet.
Answer the questionnaire as displayed on your device.
If the layout does not work well, try using a supported desktop browser.
important_conditions: The published survey design adapts to different screen sizes and resolutions.
Some surveys may contain complex questions or layouts that are easier to answer on a larger screen.
